approval_ordering_and_binding.clause: preference is not artifact approval; full-script approval before music; storyboard approval before video; bindings must match current digests

complete_fixture_validates.clause: schema validates a complete fixture (identity, world, cast, scene)

identity_survives_world_revision.clause: identity record has no world binding, so a setting change cannot rewrite it (structural only)

invalid_scene_reference_refused.clause: valid cast/location references; stale world revision refused

missing_cast_refused.clause: absent cast fields fail closed; missing cast prevents script

missing_foundation_refused.clause: missing foundations cannot bypass the gate; missing world/story plan prevents script

no_future_artifact_deadlock.clause: runtime graph has no future-artifact deadlock

one_line_scene_refused.clause: one-line placeholders and beat-only records fail new generation

package_seam_and_differences.clause: adapters preserve package differences; each flavor resolves through one seam
